Name: Stoner Valley
Author: BongWaterrr
Description:
[size=5][b]Features:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]New area accessible through the railroad. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]7 strains of weed to grow, including one during winter. (more planned for the future!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]7 new THC-infused cooking recipes.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]4 new machines.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]4 new artisan goods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Process your weed into blunts, package it into jars, concentrate it into a fine wax, or melt it down into cannabutter.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]A new NPC, Bizz! You can buy the new seeds from his trailer once the railroad has been unlocked.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Gift your weed and weed products to villagers. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Sell your products for high profit![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Powerful end-game item available to purchase at the trailer after adding Leo to your friends list.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#ff0000]IMPORTANT:[/color] [/b]If you add this mod to an existing save file, you [b]MUST [/b]sleep one night before all features become available. Starting a new save is recommended as it will grant access to every nook and cranny this mod adds (i.e. letters in the mail, certain things being locked behind dates, etc), however it works perfectly fine with existing saves (as long as you sleep one day after adding it!). Also, if you are having issues with the location of Stoner Valley's entrance, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and change CaveLocation to MoveCave. This moves the cave to another spot and should resolve any issues.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue with the mod not loading on the newest Windows 11 update. If 1.3.1 still runs fine without any errors in the SMAPI console upon launch, this update is not required. But just in case, I recommend installing 1.3.2.
